landing.headline: Know exactly where your money goes
landing.subhead: Log each day's expenses in seconds. After a couple of months you'll see your patterns and can set budgets that actually fit your life.
landing.f1Body: Amount, category, done. Works great on your phone.
landing.f2Body: Monthly totals, category breakdowns and trends across months.
landing.f3Body: Get budget suggestions from your last 3 months and watch your progress.
landing.f4Body: Use the app in English or Bangla, switch any time.
landing.metaTitle: Hisab: a simple expense tracker for your daily spending
landing.metaDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, see where your money goes, and set a monthly budget from your real numbers. Free, in Bangla and English, and works like an app on your phone.
landing.whyBody: It sounds too simple to matter. The research says otherwise.
landing.finalTitle: Your first entry takes less than a minute
landing.finalBody: Free, no card needed. Start with today's tea and rickshaw.

install.title: Install {app}
install.intro: Add {app} to your device and open it like any other app.
install.benefitFast: One tap from your home screen, dock or taskbar
install.benefitFull: Full screen, without the browser bars
install.benefitDevices: Works on phone, PC and Mac
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in the browser toolbar (in Safari it may be under the ••• menu).
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”. {app} will appear on your home screen.
install.macStep1: In Safari, open the File menu, or click the Share button.
install.macStep3: Click “Add”. {app} will open from your Dock like any app.
install.settingsHint: Use {app} like a native app on your phone, PC or Mac.
